purpose: Compile the learned input-dependent relation into a target-only three-part program
scope: Source1 and target2, exposed development sentences. Freeze the learned target dictionary. Fit the same signed, capacity-constrained target gates from either source fields or learned program fields on the original 192 fit pairs. Evaluate the original eleven part/composition requests on 96 separate development pairs.
statistics_unit: Paired sentences within three fixed grammatical paradigms and one fixed source-target pair
threshold_source_split: Original source-only R26 members; compilation uses only the original fit states
primary_endpoint: Source-effect-normalized margin RMSE on seven original untrained requests, averaged equally across fixed grammars. Compare target-only programs compiled from learned and source fields with the original dynamic program and readout.
budget: One representative two-pair evaluation and the full development comparison within 1800 driver seconds, 14 GB VRAM and 1 GB bulk. Frozen target parameters; two matched 512-step gate fits; no target response gradients or new source program training.
